A subsequent operator power cycle and exact postflight now verify normal p1 system/profile/kernel/init, three active services, all eight unchanged boot-file hashes and native Home. Mainline root/touch/restart remain unproved; the revised probe has not run on the board. Group 5d now records four separate source/API, full kernel, matching bundle and physical restart gates; implementation is underway. The vendor-derived restart source now passes Nix patch construction and a warning-free pinned-header RISC-V object check; complete kernel build and physical reset are separate open gates. Root-path inspection confirms MMC/ext4 are built in and SD partitions enumerate before unused-clock cleanup. Unconsumed SD clocks are a source-backed hypothesis; the next discriminator is a separately gated direct root-label read.
